summary: Hexo SSG installation and content generation verification on Test Cloud Server (120.24.114.13). Scope: (1) promo-hexo-ssg — install Hexo CLI, init /opt/argo-website, install and configure Butterfly or Icarus theme; (2) promo-content-generation — verify hexo generate produces static HTML to public/. Decision baseline: .argo/history/decision-tree/20260807-argo-promo-website-deploy.md#B1,B2.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: SSH into Test Cloud Server (120.24.114.13) as root and verify Hexo CLI installation, site initialization at /opt/argo-website, and Butterfly or Icarus theme configuration.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: hexo version returns installed version; hexo init produces project scaffold with _config.yml, source/, themes/, scaffolds/; _config.yml references Butterfly or Icarus theme and theme directory exists.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: PROMO_HEXO_SSG_NOT_READY: Hexo CLI not installed; Site directory not initialized; Theme not configured (expected Butterfly or Icarus). Node.js v22.22.1 detected; SSH connectivity verified.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Place a sample Markdown file with valid Hexo front-matter in source/_posts and run hexo generate.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: hexo g exits 0 without front-matter parse errors; public/ directory contains index.html; sample content appears in generated output.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: PROMO_CONTENT_GEN_SITE_NOT_INITIALIZED: Hexo site directory not found. Run promo-hexo-ssg installation first.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: Promo Deployment Architecture Boundary Guard
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Verify harness exports createPromoDeploymentHarness with all required business-readable methods, entrypoints export run(), and OVERALL_ARCHITECTURE.md contains promo-hexo-ssg and promo-content-generation implements mappings.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: All required methods present; both entrypoints export run(); implements mappings exist in root contract.

codingTargets.nextAction: SSH into 120.24.114.13 as root and: (1) npm install -g hexo-cli, (2) hexo init /opt/argo-website, (3) cd /opt/argo-website && npm install hexo-theme-butterfly (or hexo-theme-icarus), (4) set theme in _config.yml. Harness may be modified only for SSH command format or error handling fixes; public API must be preserved.

Complete promo-hexo-ssg installation (T1-T3) first. Then place a sample Markdown post and verify hexo generate succeeds. Harness may be modified only for SSH command format or error handling fixes; public API must be preserved.

tasks.title: Install Hexo CLI on Remote Server
tasks.objective: SSH into Test Cloud Server (120.24.114.13) as root and install Hexo CLI globally via npm.
steps: ssh root@120.24.114.13 'hexo version' to verify installation
tasks.completionSignal: node tests/explicit/entries/runPromoHexoSSG.js reports hexoVersion is not null

tasks.title: Initialize Hexo Site Directory
tasks.objective: Initialize Hexo site at /opt/argo-website on the remote server.
tasks.completionSignal: node tests/explicit/entries/runPromoHexoSSG.js reports scaffold.exists, configExists, hasSourceDir, hasThemesDir, hasScaffoldsDir all true

tasks.title: Install and Configure Theme
tasks.objective: Install Butterfly or Icarus theme and configure _config.yml.
steps: ssh root@120.24.114.13 'cd /opt/argo-website && npm install hexo-theme-butterfly' (or hexo-theme-icarus as fallback)
ssh root@120.24.114.13 'cd /opt/argo-website && sed -i "s/^theme:.*/theme: butterfly/" _config.yml || echo "theme: butterfly" >> _config.yml'
tasks.completionSignal: node tests/explicit/entries/runPromoHexoSSG.js reports themeValid is true and themeInstalled is true

tasks.title: Verify Content Generation
tasks.objective: Place a sample Markdown post and verify hexo generate produces static HTML.
steps: Place sample Markdown with valid front-matter in /opt/argo-website/source/_posts/
tasks.completionSignal: node tests/explicit/entries/runPromoContentGen.js reports allPassed is true (exit 0, public/ exists, index.html exists, no front-matter errors)
